gz-criterion-1954.title: Godzilla (1954) — The Criterion Collection
gz-criterion-1954.notes: 1954 film credits and synopsis; 1956 American re-edit; archival interviews with performers and effects makers are listed as extras.

gz-bfi-1954.title: Godzilla — BFI Southbank Programme Notes (2021)
gz-bfi-1954.notes: Original-film crew and cast credits; 1954 Japan production; critique of American-version changes.

gz-ryfle-2019.title: Steve Ryfle, Reign of Destruction — Criterion (2019)
gz-ryfle-2019.notes: Detailed Shōwa film/industry history, original Lucky Dragon context, later tonal changes, and children’s exhibition.

gz-nuclear-2018.title: Gojira (1954) — National Museum of Nuclear Science & History (2018)
gz-nuclear-2018.notes: Castle Bravo, Lucky Dragon, Japanese nuclear anxieties, the film and the Oxygen Destroyer dilemma.

gz-lucky-dragon-2024.title: Steve Brown, Of tuna, godzilla, and the Daigo Fukuryu Maru — International Journal of Heritage Studies (2024)
gz-lucky-dragon-2024.notes: Crew of 23, timing and circumstances of Castle Bravo exposure, heritage and political aftermath.

gz-tsutsui-2024.title: William M. Tsutsui, Is Your War over Now? — Humanities 13(6), 158 (2024)
gz-tsutsui-2024.notes: Nuanced account of postwar memory and complicated, sometimes conflicting interpretations of Honda and the 1954 film.

gz-hoberman-2012.title: J. Hoberman, Godzilla: Poetry After the A-Bomb — Criterion (2012)
gz-hoberman-2012.notes: Critical description of the 1954 film’s images, sound, and nuclear themes.

gz-criterion-showa.title: Godzilla: The Showa-Era Films, 1954–1975 — Criterion Collection
gz-criterion-showa.notes: All fifteen films, release order, credits, and lists of crew interviews and historical essays.

gz-criterion-showa-index.title: Godzilla: The Showa-Era Films — Criterion Channel index
gz-criterion-showa-index.notes: Film-by-film original-release years and basic synopses of the Japanese Shōwa cycle.

gz-toho-film-guide.title: All Godzilla Movies — Toho official Godzilla film guide
gz-toho-film-guide.notes: Original studio listings, official release years and film-by-film makers and story summaries.

gz-banno-interview.title: Brett Homenick and Damon Foster interview Yoshimitsu Banno, Vantage Point Interviews (2017; revised 2021)
gz-banno-interview.notes: Director’s firsthand reflections on making Godzilla vs. Hedorah, circumstances, staff and budgets; retrospective and translated, not an objective transcript of every production decision.

gz-acmi-hedorah.title: Luke Goodsell, Trash of the titans: Godzilla vs. Hedorah — ACMI (2024)
gz-acmi-hedorah.notes: Visual and ecological analysis of 1971 film and its reception; includes named firsthand performer reflections.

gz-champion-festival.title: Toho Champion Festival — Toho Kingdom exhibition program record
gz-champion-festival.notes: Detailed original screening program, including 1969 All Monsters Attack.
